Returns active, available, unheld drivers with a bound vehicle in the order property whose grade matches the order class. Excludes unbound and out-of-service vehicles. Filters before pagination. Resolve the pickup time to its business date and period before querying ON_DUTY drivers. Before 07:00 uses the previous date NIGHT shift; schedule filtering precedes pagination.

post.summary: Preview a batch of shifts without writes.
post.description: Requires dispatch:write. Only the selected period is queried. Drivers may have different periods on the same business date. Existing driver-date-period shifts are retained, independent of any legacy stored property; other periods do not block creation. Inaccessible existing shift details are omitted. At most 31 calendar days and 1000 combinations. Weekdays use ISO numbering, 1 = Monday and 7 = Sunday. Returns actual fields of visible existing shifts. Validation errors return 400; no business data is written. propertyId is an optional driver filter. Selected drivers may belong to different visible properties when the filter is omitted. Properties are resolved from current drivers and never stored on shifts or batch results.

post.summary: Create a batch of shifts atomically.
post.description: Requires dispatch:write. Only the selected period is queried. Drivers may have different periods on the same business date. Existing driver-date-period shifts are retained, independent of any legacy stored property; other periods do not block creation. Inaccessible existing shift details are omitted. At most 31 calendar days and 1000 combinations. Requires Idempotency-Key and the latest matching previewHash. Changes detected before commit return 409 with errors[].field = previewHash. A legacy driver-date index blocking multiple periods returns 503/50300 with errors[].field = scheduling and requires an administrator to apply the database migration; previewing again does not resolve it. All new shifts, audit records, batch result and idempotency record commit together. Identical retries replay the original batch within the configured idempotency window; reused keys with different bodies return 409. propertyId is an optional driver filter. Selected drivers may belong to different visible properties when the filter is omitted. Properties are resolved from current drivers and never stored on shifts or batch results.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Keep the same key and body when retrying an uncertain result.

201.description: Batch created, or an identical request replayed.

409.description: Preview changed, concurrent conflict, or same idempotency key used with a different body (40900).

get.summary: SH01 Query shifts by business date or pickup time.
get.description: With pickupAt (ISO 8601 UTC to seconds), first resolve the configured business timezone, shift date and period, then query ON_DUTY drivers for that period only. Before 07:00 uses the previous date NIGHT shift. Responds with one period; without pickupAt, date defaults to today and all three periods are returned. pickupAt and date are mutually exclusive (40001). Property authorization and vehicle binding follow the current driver record. No caching.

get.summary: SH08 Query shift boards for a business-date range.
get.description: Returns every business date in the inclusive range and all three periods, including empty days. At most 31 dates are allowed. Property authorization and filtering match the daily board. Shifts and distinct driver names are loaded in batches. Cache-Control: no-store. Property filtering and authorization follow the current driver record, including historical shifts. Legacy shift propertyId values are ignored. Vehicle plates are read from the current driver binding and never from legacy shift vehiclePlate or vehicleSlot fields.

post.summary: Withdraw one driver shift or the confirmed period.
post.description: Requires dispatch:write. All targets must be visible, match the business date, period and optional property, and have current versions. isWholePeriod also checks the complete active period snapshot. Other periods are untouched. Retains withdrawnAt/withdrawnBy, original shift details and audits; releases driver and vehicle occupancy. Transactional, with no partial withdrawal. Already withdrawn target IDs are harmless on retry, including after replacement shifts are created. Requires the active-shift index defined in the initial Dispatch DDL and the absence of obsolete full unique indexes; otherwise returns 503 without writes. Responses are not cached. Target visibility and the property filter follow the current driver property.
